destinations.name: Eden Nature Park

fields.planning_notes: Hiking visitors: use the park's ravine and boulder-path hiking trail; confirm trail access and weather with staff. The separate guided shuttle is 45 minutes and is not the hiking activity. Trail and general park visit durations vary.

destinations.source: https://www.edennaturepark.com.ph/ — current operator page explicitly describes Hiking Trail; do not substitute the 45-minute shuttle duration for a hike.

destinations.name: Philippine Eagle Center

fields.planning_notes: Plan the operator's 45-minute Into the Wild guided tour. Arrange availability with the Philippine Eagle Foundation before travel; this itinerary is not a reservation. Additional self-guided time is separate.

destinations.source: https://www.philippineeaglefoundation.org/service-page/into-the-wild-tour — published named guided experience, 45 minutes; not a universal duration for every type of PEC visit.

destinations.name: Elysia Wellness Spa

fields.planning_notes: Obrero branch, corner Lacson and Cervantes. Current brand posts list daily 13:00–00:00; reserve the desired treatment and reconfirm its length. Older directories list different times.

destinations.source: https://www.findhealthclinics.org/PH/Davao-City/302618053225984/Elysia-Wellness-Spa — mirror of operator posts, including 2026-09-28 daily 13:00–00:00 and Obrero contact 0917-625-3040. Direct operator site unavailable; current operator-post evidence, not direct telephone confirmation.

destinations.name: National Museum of the Philippines - Davao

fields.planning_notes: Allow two hours for the regional museum's comprehensive gallery tour, as allocated in the 2026 Citizen's Charter. Guided services require advance booking; allow additional registration/feedback time and confirm visit-date closures. Self-guided visits vary. This itinerary does not reserve a guide.

destinations.source: https://reservation.nationalmuseum.gov.ph/reservation/book/region-museum explicitly lists Davao daily 09:00–18:00; https://weblinks.nationalmuseum.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/31132441/NMP-CC_FY2026_1stEdition.pdf pp136–137 allocates 2h to the regional comprehensive guided tour, separately from administration. Replaces older 09:00–17:00 reports; not a fixed mandatory self-guided duration.

restaurant_updates.name: New Davao Famous Restaurant Corp
restaurant_updates.source: https://www.newdavaofamous.com/ and https://www.newdavaofamous.com/contact-us — Magsaysay main branch. Homepage lists 07:30–21:30 and contact page 07:00–21:00: use only the common service window 07:30–21:00; full branch schedule still needs operator reconciliation.

restaurants.name: VANDA — Park Inn by Radisson Davao
restaurants.source: https://www.radissonhotels.com/en-us/hotels/park-inn-davao/dining — operator names VANDA, daily breakfast buffet 06:00–10:00 and a la carte 06:00–23:00; walk-ins available. Property coordinates inherited from the verified hotel point.

restaurants.name: Marinatuna — Rogen Inn Compound
restaurants.source: https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1704721/davao-inn-houses-davaos-best-food-brands identifies the compound's breakfast provider; https://www.hotels.com/ho2540623552/rogen-inn-davao-philippines/ and https://ph.trip.com/hotels/davao-hotel-detail-95449117/rogen-inn/ corroborate guest breakfast 06:30–10:00; https://app.wanderlog.com/place/details/9154016/marina-tuna-rogen-inn-compound lists daily 06:00–22:00 and https://restaurantguru.com/grilled-tuna-Davao-City-m800/3 corroborates 22:00 closing. Conservative common window 06:30–22:00. Mixed property-policy and directory evidence; current direct operator confirmation unavailable. No free meal or room inclusion promised.

restaurants.name: Rhapsody Asian Fusion — Aria Hotel & Residences
restaurants.source: https://ariahotel.com.ph/dining/ identifies Rhapsody as all-day dining. Exact service hours not published; remain unknown. Hotel coordinates identify the host building, not an independently surveyed restaurant door.

restaurants.name: Jollibee Davao Bolton
restaurants.location: Bolton Street corner J.P. Rizal Street, Barangay 12-B, Davao City
restaurants.source: https://order.jollibee.com/en/ph/stores/jollibee-davao-bolton — operator lists dine-in and daily 24-hour opening. Operator Directions link supplies 7.066192,125.609328. Fulfilment schedules may vary; purchases are not included.

restaurants.name: Vista Restaurant — Eden Nature Park
restaurants.source: https://www.edennaturepark.com.ph/ explicitly names Vista Restaurant. Restaurant-specific service hours not published on the page; park gate hours are not copied as dining hours. Park admission and buffet arrangements require confirmation.

restaurants.name: Resto-Beach — Paradise Island Park & Beach Resort
restaurants.source: https://paradiseislandsamal.com/dining/ names Resto-Beach and describes lunch/dinner and Island Cafe breakfast. Exact restaurant service hours remain unknown; private boat timetable is not substituted for dining hours. Confirm day-pass access.

remaining_evidence_gaps: Bankerohan and Osmeña Park: no current authoritative uniform visitor schedule; stall hours do not establish market-wide meal availability.
Kaputian Beach: municipal listing confirms identity, but no current official gate/treatment schedule or fixed visitor duration was located.
Belviz, Bemwa, Bukid Amara, Agriya and Isla Agri-Ventures: incomplete or conflicting schedules; locality, farm identity and old corporate hours are not visitor access confirmation.
IMIN: government/historical schedules and directories disagree over Saturday/Sunday booking requirements; current operator confirmation still needed.
Open parks, markets, beaches and self-guided heritage sites have variable stay lengths. No universal fixed duration is fabricated.
No new sample listing, sample certificate, invented fee or unlocated summit is added to fill interest coverage.
